notes: These are zustand stores from a React app; this crate has NO GPUI dependency. Port each store as a plain struct holding the state with methods for its actions (same names in snake_case, same rules such as 'never close the last tab'). Where a store persists itself (zustand `persist` or direct localStorage calls), keep the same storage key and the same JSON shape, behind a small `Storage` trait defined once in this crate (get/set/remove a string by key) with an in-memory implementation for tests and a file-backed one (one JSON file holding all keys, written atomically); the store takes `&dyn Storage` when loading and saving. Stores that call `window.rev.*` (IPC to the main process) take that dependency as a trait or closure argument. Do not port React hooks; skip code that only exists to trigger re-rendering.
